description: Live NOAA weather for the aviation radar lane. lane=weather returns real convective SIGMET hazard polygons (aviationweather.gov airsigmet) with altitude tops and movement vectors; lane=space returns real GOES-R primary X-ray flux plus NOAA scales, planetary K and OVATION aurora. No mock radar: an empty result is empty, a failed fetch is CURE.
name: noaa_goes_r_weather
